categories.main_business_segments: Hebei Keli Automobile Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of automotive glass assembly components. Its main products include windshield installation components, side window glass lifting components, corner window glass assembly components, and other automotive parts. The company focuses on serving automotive glass manufacturers and has expanded to supply vehicle manufacturers as well.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced core technologies in mold design, product synchronous development, and integrated product solutions. Key proprietary technologies include noise reduction, anti-warping, integrated molding of edge strips, camera bracket anti-fog and stray light suppression, flush side window guide rail technology, self-locking and rapid curing of side window glass brackets, and high-precision mold development. Production methods emphasize automation and intelligent manufacturing, integrating ERP, MES, APS, WMS, and other systems to optimize production scheduling and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major global automotive glass manufacturers such as Fuyao Glass, AGC, NSG, and Saint-Gobain, as well as vehicle manufacturers including Great Wall Motors and Dongfeng Nissan. Its products are widely used in automotive glass assemblies, targeting both domestic and international automotive markets, with a strong presence in the automotive glass supply chain.
categories.geographic_coverage: Hebei Keli operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Qinhuangdao, Hebei Province. It also has overseas operations, including a subsidiary in the United States (Keli Automotive Parts, Inc.). The company’s sales cover domestic markets and international markets, with overseas sales accounting for approximately 27.58% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of automotive glass assembly components. It supplies first-tier automotive glass manufacturers and vehicle manufacturers, positioning itself as a key component supplier within the automotive glass assembly industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes technological innovation, production automation, professional team development, and systematic management. R&D focuses on new materials, intelligent components, and environmentally friendly technologies such as VOC-free camera brackets, electroluminescent materials, and alternatives to chrome plating and anodizing. The company also plans to expand into new business areas like low-altitude economic sectors and new energy vehicle components, aiming to enhance global competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized automotive glass assembly components to automotive glass manufacturers and vehicle manufacturers. The company signs annual framework agreements with customers and fulfills orders based on customer demand, with sales recognized at the point of product transfer. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hebei Keli is one of the largest domestic suppliers of injection-molded and extruded automotive glass assembly components in China. It holds a leading position in product variety and model coverage within the automotive glass assembly sector. The industry is concentrated with major global glass manufacturers, but direct competitors in the exact product segment are limited, giving the company a strong competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 611.7 million, a 25.41% increase over 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 150.2 million, up 9.59%. Total assets grew by 121.09% to RMB 1.38 billion, reflecting rapid expansion. The company has shown steady growth in production and sales volumes, particularly in extruded products, driven by increased orders for windshield installation components.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through comprehensive product offerings covering the widest range of automotive glass assembly components, strong synchronous development capabilities with customers, advanced proprietary technologies, and intelligent manufacturing processes. It emphasizes high product quality, customization, rapid response to customer needs, and cost leadership, supported by stable relationships with leading global automotive glass manufacturers.
